##Normalising the data.soft

```{r}
Data.soft <- as.data.frame(Data.soft)
Data.soft_subset <- Data.soft[, !(names(Data.soft) %in% c("u3n_metabBiocrP500_ff4", 
                                                          "u3csex", 
                                                          "u3tbmiwho", 
                                                          "u3twhratc", 
                                                          "u3twhoish", 
                                                          "u3tdm110y15", 
                                                          "u3tmsidfup"))]

numeric_cols <- names(Data.soft_subset)[sapply(Data.soft_subset, is.numeric)]  # Get names of numeric columns
#### Apply the transformation to each numeric column in the original Data.soft and then viewing the data 
Data.soft[numeric_cols] <- lapply(Data.soft[numeric_cols], function(col) { 
  qnorm((rank(col, na.last = "keep") - 0.5) / sum(!is.na(col)))
})
```

##Defining and Identifying the archetypes based on the tresshold
```{r}
Extreme.archetype_indices <- which(assignments_a4 > 0.7, arr.ind = TRUE)
Participants.number <- data.frame(
  Participant_Number = Extreme.archetype_indices[, 1],
  Archetype_Number = Extreme.archetype_indices[, 2]
)
Merged.Metabolomics.Data.soft$Extreme_Archetype_Number <- NA
for (i in 1:nrow(Participants.number)) {
  participant_id <- Participants.number$Participant_Number[i]
  archetype_id <- Participants.number$Archetype_Number[i]
  
  Merged.Metabolomics.Data.soft$Extreme_Archetype_Number[participant_id] <- archetype_id
}
mixed_etiology <- which(apply(assignments_a4, 1, function(x) all(x < 0.7)))
Merged.Metabolomics.Data.soft$Extreme_Archetype_Number[mixed_etiology] <- "Mixed Etiology"
```



#Running linear regression only for the proteins (outcome :archetype and exposure : protein and covariates: adjust for age and sex)
```{r}
clinical_vars <- Merged.Metabolomics.Data.soft[, c("u3talteru", "u3csex")]
archetype_vars <- Merged.Metabolomics.Data.soft[, c("Archetypes 1", "Archetypes 2", "Archetypes 3", "Archetypes 4")]
metabolite_vars <- Merged.Metabolomics.Data.soft[, 34:421]
results_list_metabolites <- list()
for (metabolite in colnames(metabolite_vars)) {
  metabolite_results <- list()
  
  for (archetype in colnames(archetype_vars)) {
    # Build the formula: archetype ~ protein + clinical covariates
    # Use backticks to handle spaces/special characters in column names
    formula_str <- paste0("`", archetype, "` ~ `", metabolite, "` + u3talteru + u3csex")
    model <- lm(as.formula(formula_str), data = Merged.Metabolomics.Data.soft)
    
    coefs <- summary(model)$coefficients
    conf_intervals <- confint.default(model)
    r2 <- summary(model)$r.squared
    
    # Ensure the protein is present in the coefficient table
    if (paste0("`", metabolite, "`") %in% rownames(coefs)) {
      coef_name <- paste0("`", metabolite, "`")
    } else if (metabolite %in% rownames(coefs)) {
      coef_name <- metabolite
    } else {
      coef_name <- NA
    }
    
    if (!is.na(coef_name)) {
      estimate <- coefs[coef_name, "Estimate"]
      se <- coefs[coef_name, "Std. Error"]
      p_value <- coefs[coef_name, "Pr(>|t|)"]
      ci_lower <- conf_intervals[coef_name, 1]
      ci_upper <- conf_intervals[coef_name, 2]
    } else {
      estimate <- NA
      se <- NA
      p_value <- NA
      ci_lower <- NA
      ci_upper <- NA
    }
    
    metabolite_results[[archetype]] <- data.frame(
      Metabolite = metabolite,
      Archetype = archetype,
      Estimate = estimate,
      Std_Error = se,
      P_value = p_value,
      CI_Lower = ci_lower,
      CI_Upper = ci_upper,
      R2 = r2,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  results_list_metabolites[[metabolite]] <- do.call(rbind, metabolite_results)
}
final_results_metabolites <- do.call(rbind, results_list_metabolites)
final_results_metabolites$Adjusted_P_value <- p.adjust(final_results_metabolites$P_value, method = "fdr")
write.csv(final_results_metabolites, paste0("Metabolite_Archetype_Regression_Results_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
significant_results <- final_results_metabolites[final_results_metabolites$Adjusted_P_value < 0.05, ]
head(significant_results[order(significant_results$Adjusted_P_value), ])

range(significant_results$Estimate)
```

#Linear regression for dependent variable (proteins ~ clinical varibales )
#The most discriminative omics variables were then investigated for associations with the clinical phenotypes
```{r}
clinical_vars <- Merged.Metabolomics.Data.soft[, 2:29]
metabolites_merged <- colnames(Merged.Metabolomics.Data.soft)[34:421]
metabolite_vars <- intersect(top10_metabolite$Metabolite, metabolites_merged)
# metabolite_vars <- metabolites_merged

metabolite_data <- Merged.Metabolomics.Data.soft[, metabolite_vars]
top_metabolite_clinic <- cbind(clinical_vars, metabolite_data)
results_list <- list()

for (metab in colnames(metabolite_data)) {
  for (clinical in colnames(clinical_vars)) {
    formula_str <- paste0("`", metab, "` ~ `", clinical, "`")
    model <- lm(as.formula(formula_str), data = top_metabolite_clinic)
    coefs <- summary(model)$coefficients
    conf_intervals <- confint.default(model)
    r2 <- summary(model)$r.squared
    
    # The predictor's coefficient is always the second row
    estimate <- coefs[2, "Estimate"]
    se <- coefs[2, "Std. Error"]
    p_value <- coefs[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]
    ci_lower <- conf_intervals[2, 1]
    ci_upper <- conf_intervals[2, 2]
    
    results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Metabolite = metab,
      Clinical = clinical,
      Estimate = estimate,
      Std_Error = se,
      P_value = p_value,
      CI_Lower = ci_lower,
      CI_Upper = ci_upper,
      R2 = r2,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
}

final_results <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
final_results$Adjusted_P_value <- p.adjust(final_results$P_value, method = "fdr")
write.csv(final_results, paste0("metabolite_clinical_Regression_Results_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
significant_results_metabolite_clinical <- final_results[final_results$Adjusted_P_value < 0.05, ]
head(significant_results_metabolite_clinical[order(significant_results_metabolite_clinical$Adjusted_P_value), ])

```

##Heatmap for the archetypes and clinical vaiables 
```{r}
heatmap_matrix <- significant_results_metabolite_clinical %>%
  dplyr::select(Adjusted_P_value, Archetype, Estimate, Clinical_Variable) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Archetype, values_from = Adjusted_P_value) %>%
  as.data.frame()


# Set short names as rownames and remove the column
colnames(heatmap_matrix) <- heatmap_matrix$Clinical_Variable
row.names(heatmap_matrix) <- heatmap_matrix$Archetype
heatmap_matrix <- as.matrix(heatmap_matrix)
heatmap_matrix <- type.convert(heatmap_matrix, as.is = TRUE)
heatmap_matrix[!is.finite(heatmap_matrix)] <- 0
max_abs_value <- max(abs(heatmap_matrix))
color_breaks <- c(-max_abs_value, -max_abs_value/2, 0, max_abs_value/2, max_abs_value)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  breaks = color_breaks,
  colors = c("darkblue", "dodgerblue", "#FFFDD0", "salmon", "darkred"),
  space = "LAB"
)
ht <- Heatmap(
  matrix = heatmap_matrix,
  name = "Estimate",
  col = col_fun,
  
  # Row settings - names on right
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_side = "right",  # Changed from "left" to "right"
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold"),
  
  # Column settings
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_rot = 0,
  column_names_centered = TRUE,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  
  # Heatmap appearance
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "gray", lwd = 0.5),
  border = TRUE,
  na_col = "lightgray",
  
  # Clustering
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  
  # Legend settings
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Odds Ratio",
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
    legend_height = unit(4, "cm"),
    at = color_breaks,
    labels = round(color_breaks, 2)
  )
)
draw(ht, 
     heatmap_legend_side = "right",
     padding = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 10), "mm")) # Right padding increased to 10mm

# Save as PNG
png("top_proteins_heatmap.png", 
    width = 2000,  # Pixel dimensions
    height = 1500, 
    res = 300)     # 300 DPI for high quality
draw(ht, padding = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 10), "mm"))
dev.off()
```


##Volcano plot
##Unique protein names(If you are using the protein, should be unique otherwise plot them in shapes)
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(stringr)
significant_results$negLog10P <- -log10(significant_results$Adjusted_P_value)


# Label directionality based on effect size thresholds
significant_results$significant <- "Not"  # Default: Not Significant
significant_results$significant[significant_results$Adjusted_P_value < 0.05 & significant_results$Estimate > 0.2] <- "Up"
significant_results$significant[significant_results$Adjusted_P_value < 0.05 & significant_results$Estimate < -0.2] <- "Down"

# Convert to factor with explicit levels
significant_results$direction <- factor(significant_results$significant, 
                                        levels = c("Not", "Up", "Down"))

# Add Protein labels for significant proteins short name hits only
significant_results$label <- ifelse(
  significant_results$significant != "Not",
  significant_results$Metabolite,
  NA
)

# Volcano plot with directional coloring
ggplot(significant_results, aes(x = Estimate, y = negLog10P, color = significant, shape = Archetype)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("blue","grey","red")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.2, 0.2), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +#Adds vertical dashed lines at x = -0.1 and x = 0.2.
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot of Proteins",
       x = "Effect Size",
       y = "-Log10(P-value)",
       color = "significant")
```

##Creating the bubble plot archetyps vs proteins
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
top10_proteins <- significant_results %>%
  group_by(Archetype) %>%
  arrange(Adjusted_P_value, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()
top10_proteins <- top10_proteins %>%
  mutate(
    Protein_Short = case_when(
      str_detect(Protein, "\\|[A-Za-z0-9\\.]+_HUMAN") ~ str_extract(Protein, "(?<=\\|)[A-Za-z0-9\\.]+(?=_HUMAN)"),
      str_detect(Protein, "__[A-Z0-9]+_HUMAN") ~ str_extract(Protein, "(?<=__)[A-Z0-9]+(?=_HUMAN)"),
      TRUE ~ Protein
    )
  )
top10_proteins <- top10_proteins %>%
  group_by(Archetype) %>%
  mutate(Protein_Short_Unique = make.unique(Protein_Short)) %>%
  ungroup()
top10_proteins <- top10_proteins %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log10_p = -log10(Adjusted_P_value)
  )
p <- ggplot(top10_proteins, 
            aes(x = Archetype, y = Protein_Short_Unique, size = neg_log10_p, color = Estimate)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "brown", midpoint = 0, name = "Effect Size"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "-log10",
    range = c(3, 10)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Archetype-Specific Proteins",
    x = "Archetype", y = "Protein"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )

print(p)
ggsave("Archetype_Proteomics_Bubble_Plot.png", p, 
       width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```


##Create a forest plot (archetypes and significant metabolites)
```{r}
top_metabolite_long <- top10_metabolite %>%
  group_by(Archetype, Metabolite, CI_Lower, CI_Upper) %>%
  mutate(
    Metabolite_Short_Unique = ifelse(duplicated(Metabolite), 
                                  paste0(Metabolite, "_", Archetype), 
                                  Metabolite)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()



# Clean and prepare your data
df_forest <- top_metabolite_long %>%
  mutate(
    Metabolite = factor(Metabolite_Short_Unique, levels = rev(unique(Metabolite))),  # reverse for better layout
    Archetype = factor(Archetype, levels = unique(Archetype))  # keep consistent order
  )

# Create forest plot
ggplot(df_forest, aes(x = Estimate, y = Metabolite, color = Archetype)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), size = 2) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_Lower, xmax = CI_Upper),
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), height = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  facet_wrap(~ Archetype, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  xlab("Estimate with 95% CI")

ggsave("forest.plot4.png", width = 9, height = length(unique(df_forest$Metabolite)) * 0.4, dpi = 600, bg = "white")

ggsave("forest.plot4.pdf", width = 9, height = 10, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```

#Ultimate the for combined plots of heatmap and the bubble plot
```{r}
# --- LIBRARIES ---
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(stringr)

# Ensure metabolite and archetype order are fixed and consistent
metabolite_levels <- union(
  unique(top10_metabolite$Metabolite),
  unique(significant_results_metabolite_clinical$Metabolite)
)
archetype_levels <- unique(top10_metabolite$Archetype)

# --- Tile data for heatmap ---
tile_data <- top10_metabolite %>%
  mutate(
    Metabolite = factor(Metabolite, levels = rev(metabolite_levels)),
    Archetype = factor(Archetype, levels = archetype_levels)
  )

# --- Significance stars column ---
get_significance <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  else if (p < 0.01) return("**")
  else if (p < 0.05) return("*")
  else return("")
}
tile_data$stars <- sapply(tile_data$Adjusted_P_value, get_significance)
tile_data_full <- tidyr::complete(
  tile_data,
  Metabolite = metabolite_levels,
  Archetype = archetype_levels,
  fill = list(Estimate = NA, stars = "")
)

# --- Bubble plot data (make all metabolites present, fill missing with NA) ---

significant_results_metabolite_clinical <- significant_results_metabolite_clinical %>%
  mutate(Clinical = recode(Clinical,
                                    "u3talteru" = "Age",
                                    "u3csex" = "Gender",
                                    "u3tgewi" = "Weight",
                                    "u3tgroe" = "Height",
                                    "u3tbmi" = "BMI",
                                    "u3tbmiwho" = "WHO_BMI_Category",
                                    "u3twhrat" = "WHR",
                                    "u3twhratc" = "WHR_Category",
                                    "u3tsysmm" = "SBP",
                                    "u3tdiamm" = "DBP",
                                    "u3twhoish" = "Hypertension",
                                    "u3tglukfastn" = "Fasting_glucose",
                                    "u3tgluk2n" = "Glucose_2h",
                                    "u3tdm110y15" = "Diabetes_WHO",
                                    "u3tinsfastn" = "Fasting_serum_insulin",
                                    "u3tins2n" = "Insulin_2h",
                                    "u3tmsidfup" = "Metabolic_Syndrome_IDF",
                                    "u3thoma2_b" = "HOMA_Beta",
                                    "u3thoma2_s" = "HOMA_Sensitivity",
                                    "u3thoma2_ir" = "HOMA_IR",
                                    "u3tquickin" = "Insulin_Sensitivity_Quicki",
                                    "u3lk_choln" = "Cholesterol",
                                    "u3lk_hdln" = "HDL",
                                    "u3lk_ldln" = "LDL",
                                    "u3lk_trin" = "TG",
                                    "u3lk_krean" = "Creatinine",
                                    "u3l_hbavn" = "HbA1c",
                                    "u3h_crp" = "hsCRP"
  ))
# Make a full grid for bubble plot, so every Metabolite (in the agreed order) appears
phenotype_levels <- unique(significant_results_metabolite_clinical$Clinical)
bubble_data_full <- tidyr::complete(
  significant_results_metabolite_clinical %>%
    mutate(
      neg_log10_p = -log10(P_value),  # or Adjusted_P_value
      Metabolite = factor(Metabolite, levels = rev(metabolite_levels))
    ),
  Metabolite = metabolite_levels,
  Clinical = phenotype_levels
)
col_fun <- colorRampPalette(c("darkblue", "dodgerblue", "#FFFDD0", "salmon", "darkred"))
max_abs_value <- max(abs(tile_data$Estimate), na.rm = TRUE)
color_breaks <- seq(-max_abs_value, max_abs_value, length.out = 5)

p_heatmap <- ggplot(tile_data_full, aes(x = Archetype, y = Metabolite, fill = Estimate)) +
  geom_tile(color = "gray", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = col_fun(100),
    limits = c(-max_abs_value, max_abs_value),
    breaks = color_breaks,
    labels = round(color_breaks, 2),
    name = "Estimate",
    na.value = "white"
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = stars), size = 8, fontface = "bold", na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0)
  )
p_heatmap
p_bubble <- ggplot(bubble_data_full,
                   aes(x = Clinical, y = Metabolite, size = neg_log10_p, color = Estimate)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_gradient2(
```

```{r}
# --- LIBRARIES ---
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# ==============================
# ==============================

# If TRUE, non-significant heatmap cells become white
mask_nonsig_heatmap <- FALSE

# ==============================
# ==============================

# Use ONLY metabolites from the heatmap as the reference list
metabolite_levels <- unique(top10_metabolite$Metabolite)
archetype_levels  <- unique(top10_metabolite$Archetype)

# ==============================
# ==============================

get_significance <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  if (p < 0.01)  return("**")
  if (p < 0.05)  return("*")
  return("")
}

tile_data <- top10_metabolite %>%
  mutate(
    stars = sapply(Adjusted_P_value, get_significance),
    Metabolite = factor(Metabolite, levels = rev(metabolite_levels)),
    Archetype  = factor(Archetype, levels = archetype_levels)
  )

# Optional: mask non-significant cells
if (mask_nonsig_heatmap) {
  tile_data <- tile_data %>%
    mutate(Estimate = ifelse(stars == "", NA, Estimate))
}

# Complete heatmap grid
tile_data_full <- tile_data %>%
  complete(
    Metabolite = factor(rev(metabolite_levels), levels = rev(metabolite_levels)),
    Archetype  = factor(archetype_levels, levels = archetype_levels),
    fill = list(Estimate = NA, stars = "")
  )

# Recalculate color scale from CURRENT data
max_abs_value <- max(abs(tile_data_full$Estimate), na.rm = TRUE)
color_breaks  <- seq(-max_abs_value, max_abs_value, length.out = 5)

col_fun <- colorRampPalette(c("darkblue", "dodgerblue", "#FFFDD0", "salmon", "darkred"))

# ==============================
# ==============================

bubble_data <- significant_results_metabolite_clinical %>%
  mutate(
    Clinical = recode(
      Clinical,
      "u3talteru"     = "Age",
      "u3csex"        = "Gender",
      "u3tgewi"       = "Weight",
      "u3tgroe"       = "Height",
      "u3tbmi"        = "BMI",
      "u3tbmiwho"     = "WHO_BMI_Category",
      "u3twhrat"      = "WHR",
      "u3twhratc"     = "WHR_Category",
      "u3tsysmm"      = "SBP",
      "u3tdiamm"      = "DBP",
      "u3twhoish"     = "Hypertension",
      "u3tglukfastn"  = "Fasting_glucose",
      "u3tgluk2n"     = "Glucose_2h",
      "u3tdm110y15"   = "Diabetes_WHO",
      "u3tinsfastn"   = "Fasting_serum_insulin",
      "u3tins2n"      = "Insulin_2h",
      "u3tmsidfup"    = "Metabolic_Syndrome_IDF",
      "u3thoma2_b"    = "HOMA_Beta",
      "u3thoma2_s"    = "HOMA_Sensitivity",
      "u3thoma2_ir"   = "HOMA_IR",
      "u3tquickin"    = "Insulin_Sensitivity_Quicki",
      "u3lk_choln"    = "Cholesterol",
      "u3lk_hdln"     = "HDL",
      "u3lk_ldln"     = "LDL",
      "u3lk_trin"     = "TG",
      "u3lk_krean"    = "Creatinine",
      "u3l_hbavn"     = "HbA1c",
      "u3h_crp"       = "hsCRP"
    ),
    neg_log10_p = -log10(Adjusted_P_value)
    # If you prefer raw p-values instead, replace with:
  ) %>%
  # Keep ONLY metabolites that are in the heatmap
  filter(Metabolite %in% metabolite_levels) %>%
  # Optional: remove categorical/binary phenotypes if you do not want them
  filter(!Clinical %in% c(
    "Gender",
    "WHO_BMI_Category",
    "WHR_Category",
    "Hypertension",
    "Diabetes_WHO",
    "Metabolic_Syndrome_IDF"
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    Metabolite = factor(Metabolite, levels = rev(metabolite_levels))
  )

# Keep phenotype order as it appears after filtering
phenotype_levels <- unique(bubble_data$Clinical)

# Complete bubble grid so rows align with heatmap
bubble_data_full <- bubble_data %>%
  complete(
    Metabolite = factor(rev(metabolite_levels), levels = rev(metabolite_levels)),
    Clinical   = phenotype_levels
  )

# ==============================
# ==============================

p_heatmap <- ggplot(tile_data_full, aes(x = Archetype, y = Metabolite, fill = Estimate)) +
  geom_tile(color = "gray", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = stars), size = 8, fontface = "bold", na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = col_fun(100),
    limits = c(-max_abs_value, max_abs_value),
    breaks = color_breaks,
    labels = round(color_breaks, 2),
    name = "Estimate",
    na.value = "white"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

print(p_heatmap)

# ==============================
# ==============================

p_bubble <- ggplot(
  bubble_data_full,
  aes(x = Clinical, y = Metabolite, size = neg_log10_p, color = Estimate)
) +
  geom_point(na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "blue",
    mid = "white",
    high = "brown",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Effect Size",
    na.value = "white"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "-log10(P)",
    range = c(3, 10)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Phenotypes",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90"),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

print(p_bubble)

# ==============================
# ==============================

combined <- p_heatmap + p_bubble +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1, widths = c(0.32, 0.68))

print(combined)

# ==============================
# ==============================

ggsave(
  "bubble_plot_only_metabolomics.png",
  p_bubble,
  width = 12,
  height = length(metabolite_levels) * 0.5 + 2,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  "combined_ggplot_heatmap_bubble_metabolomics.png",
  combined,
  width = 20,
  height = length(metabolite_levels) * 0.5 + 2,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  "bubble_plot_only_metabolomics.pdf",
  p_bubble,
  width = 12,
  height = length(metabolite_levels) * 0.5 + 2,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  "combined_ggplot_heatmap_bubble_metabolomics.pdf",
  combined,
  width = 18,
  height = length(metabolite_levels) * 0.5 + 2,
  bg = "white"
)

getwd()
```
